mapper.select: /*selectSellerMpClGoodsDetailInfoPopList*/ SELECT TRIM (BT.IMGFILE_DIR) AS IMGFILE_DIR, TRIM (BT.IMGFILE_NAME) AS IMGFILE_NAME, BT.CATEGORY_TEXT, BT.CATEGORY_NO, DT.BUYER_ITEM_NO, DT.DESCRIPTION, DT.SPECIFICATION, BT.UNIT_MEASURE, BT.DELIVERY_LT, (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M001' AND DT.ORIGIN_CODE = CODE) AS ORIGIN, BT.MAKER_NAME, BT.REMARK, DT.LIST_PRICE, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = DT.AGENT) AS AGENT_TEXT, TRIM (BT.IMAGE_KEY) AS IMAGE_KEY, (SELECT COUNT (*) FROM ICOMATCH WHERE DOC_NO = BT.IMAGE_KEY) AS ATTACH_CNT FROM ICOMBYIT BT, ICOMCQDT DT WHERE BT.BUYER = #{st_byit_comorg_code} AND BT.BUYER_ITEM_NO = #{st_item_no} AND BT.BUYER = DT.BUYER AND BT.BUYER_ITEM_NO = DT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND DT.CONTRACT_NO = #{st_contract_no} AND DT.CONTRACT_SEQ = #{st_contract_seq} AND BT.STATUS <> 'D' AND DT.STATUS <> 'D'

/*selectSellerMpClGoodsDetailInfoPopList*/ SELECT DECODE (TRIM (BT.IMGFILE_DIR), NULL, (SELECT IMG_DIR FROM CMSIMGES WHERE IMG_NO = CMS.IMG_NO), BT.IMGFILE_DIR) AS IMGFILE_DIR, DECODE (TRIM (BT.IMGFILE_NAME), NULL, (SELECT IMG_NAME FROM CMSIMGES WHERE IMG_NO = CMS.IMG_NO), BT.IMGFILE_NAME) AS IMGFILE_NAME, BT.CATEGORY_TEXT, BT.CATEGORY_NO, DT.BUYER_ITEM_NO, DT.DESCRIPTION, DT.SPECIFICATION, BT.UNIT_MEASURE, BT.DELIVERY_LT, (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M001' AND DT.ORIGIN_CODE = CODE) ORIGIN, BT.MAKER_NAME, BT.REMARK, DT.UNIT_PRICE, DECODE ( (SELECT MAX (agent_open_flag) FROM icomcmpy WHERE byca_comorg_code = #{st_byit_comorg_code}), 'N', '코리아e플랫폼(주)', (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = DT.AGENT)) AGENT_TEXT, DECODE ( BT.STATUS, 'D', '삭제', DECODE ( DT.STATUS, 'D', '삭제', DECODE (BT.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG, 'N', '승인', 'Y', '단종'))) AS STATUS_TEXT, TRIM (BT.IMAGE_KEY) AS IMAGE_KEY, (SELECT COUNT (*) FROM ICOMATCH WHERE DOC_NO = BT.IMAGE_KEY) AS ATTACH_CNT FROM ICOMBYIT BT, ICOMCQDT DT, CMSCATLG CMS WHERE BT.BUYER = #{st_byit_comorg_code} AND BT.BUYER_ITEM_NO = #{st_item_no} AND BT.BUYER = DT.BUYER AND BT.BUYER_ITEM_NO = DT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND DT.CONTRACT_NO = #{st_contract_no} AND DT.CONTRACT_SEQ = #{st_contract_seq} AND BT.CMS_CATLG_ID = CMS.CMS_CATLG_ID(+) AND CMS.STD_FLAG(+) = 'Y'
